Real PostgreSQL tests reject superseded or incomplete graph publication atomically. A retained negative cache cannot be bypassed while its refresh is active. Same-key admission contention coalesces within bounded waits.

retained_failures.cause: Cached digest selection ignored active fetching state after a previous negative entry. Repaired by blocking until the fenced outcome.
Concurrent same-key misses could lose local fill admission before the owner committed its lease.
Controlled PostgreSQL lock reproduced six premature same-key admission failures. Repaired with bounded lease rechecks.
